title: DollJoint 솔로 #048 · hourglass bombshell · 분라쿠 인디고 관절 · 손 허리 · 여름 해변 · 홍콩풍
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, half-up half-down ash brown hair — full body white gofun-painted wooden Japanese bunraku puppet fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is a solid gofun-painted wood body curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into smooth fitted gofun segments, and at her neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles every segment ends in a round exposed ball joint seated in its socket with a thin dark gap and its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted segments — BLAZING chalk-white gofun shell paint across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep indigo-blue painted joints and thin gold silk cords tied around every wrist, elbow and knee, soft matte shell-white, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same gofun-painted wood, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same gofun-painted wood with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, heavy gold rings on every finger, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT part of the doll body — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge.

Background: a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
